flags.why: This is a derogatory description, especially of women, and needs an explicit warning ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/chua-ngoa-eZZdmzyHPdEwc.html)).
This meaning remains in ordinary contemporary use and is misleadingly labelled rare ([usage](https://nghengu.vn/tieng-nghe-cua-toi/mup-la-gi-1246.html)).
Bút kí records observations and reflections rather than specifically meaning memoir, which is hồi kí ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/but-ki-eX9Duo5mzPeHP.html)).
flags.fix: literary sketch; nonfiction prose recording the writer's observations and reflections

flags.why: Một tập bút kí means a collection of literary sketches, whereas the translation incorrectly specifies a memoir ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/but-ki-eX9Duo5mzPeHP.html)).
flags.fix: She has just published a collection of literary sketches about her trip to the Northwest.

flags.why: This expression is mainly Southern, particularly associated with the Mekong Delta, and lacks a regional label ([regional usage](https://kenh14.vn/rop-reng-la-gi-ma-nguoi-mien-tay-hay-dung-215250928220057476.chn)).
This word has a formal register that the untagged entry does not convey ([reference](https://tudientiengviet.org/ban-doanh/)).
Chính đảng means political party without implying that the party is recognised or legitimate ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/chinh-dang-eqpcZaNK0LOBa.html)).
